description:
Following the very well-received and anticipated release of Blast Off, Wah Wah 45s' space funk meets experimental hip hop outfit, Paper Tiger, are back with a new single - Ooh.

Featuring the unmistakeable flow of LA-based rapper Pyramid Vritra (former Stones Throw signee and Odd Future affiliate), this second single is, without a doubt, a very original take on what hip hop should sound like in 2016: trippy, fit to be played in the club, but not your regular party banger - let's call it a surprise sonic journey.

Furthermore, Wah Wah 45s teamed up with two of the most hardworking beatsmiths in the game right now, J-Felix (Tru Thoughts) and Hector Plimmer (Albert's Favorites/NTS), to deliver two very distinct, but high quality remixes, and ooze even more head-nodding dust all over the record.
